title: termal_send_to_session reports "durableButNotWoken" for a root session that is woken shortly after, so the sender believes the wake was lost
outcome: The send receipt's notificationDisposition reflects what the dispatch actually did. When a wake is dispatched or queued for later delivery to an idle or busy root, the receipt says so (for example deliveredToIdleSession or queuedBehindActiveTurn), and durableButNotWoken is reserved for a send that genuinely will not wake the target. A sender can therefore tell a lost wake from a delayed one without asking a human to resume the session.
acceptance: The holder's note identifies, with file:line, the dispatch path that returns durableButNotWoken for a root that is woken shortly afterwards, using the occurrences below, and states whether the wake was deferred (for example during runtime recovery after a host restart, or a transient runtime state) or the disposition was computed before the dispatch decided.

A test reproduces the misleading disposition (a root the host will wake through a deferred path receives a durableButNotWoken receipt) and, after the fix, shows a disposition that matches the actual delivery; a test also shows durableButNotWoken is still returned when the target genuinely cannot be woken.
The full gate passes on the exact committed tree.
